_about: Sizes the Workers must stay under (scripts/perf-budget.mjs, tests/perf-budget.test.mjs). Measured on 2026-10-23 with a little room (the app grew 0.6 MB when the SDKs and schemas became lazy: each `import()` is a chunk of its own, in both of Next.js's layers, and the dashboard evaluates 1.5 MB less of it); The content calendar (2026-10-24) took the app 0.6 MB (handler 28.60 to 29.19 MB): its three dashboard pages, a docs page, 24 actions and their schemas, in both of Next.js's layers, of which the pages' client reference manifests are 0.26 MB. Raise one only in a change that says why a Worker had to grow. Bytes.
